_readme: Defaults. Do NOT edit this file: copy it to config/theme.json (or run ./install.sh --configure) and change values there. Only options that really need a human decision are exposed here.
_mode: dark | light.  'light' is EXPERIMENTAL (palette is derived from the Figma light values, not verified on screen).
_accent: 'auto' = Figma accent for the mode (dark #0091ff, light #0088ff) or any #rrggbb.

border._doc: width 0 removes the border (title bar is then exactly 32 px; with a border Openbox makes it 33 px). 'auto' = white at 23%/14% in dark mode, black at 23%/14% in light mode. Or give #rrggbb.

window._corner_radius: picom radius for normal windows. Figma: 16 (title-bar window, 16.9 best-fit for its squircle) or 26 (toolbar window).

menu._rim: thin light edge ('glass rim') on menus.

fonts._doc: Figma text is 13 px = Inter 10 pt. mono 'Maple Mono NF' is downloaded by install.sh; any installed monospace family works.

file_manager._icon_size: PCManFM-Qt Preferences > Display: big icons (icon view) and small icons (list view), in pixels: big 16-256, small 16-64.
file_manager._list_view: PCManFM-Qt folder view: detailed (list), icon, compact or thumbnail. PCManFM-Qt has no inline tree for file items, so the list is flat.

switcher._style: 'icons' = native glass overlay with 88 px icons and a selected app label; 'list' = Openbox's text list. Run the switcher module after changing this.
switcher._doc: Alt+Tab window switcher: glass look through the compositor (opacity in %, with background blur). translucent=false keeps it opaque.

menubar._hidden_tray_items: Titles of tray items collapsed behind the chevron at the left of the tray group (click it to reveal them for a few seconds). Find titles with: busctl --user get-property <service> /StatusNotifierItem org.kde.StatusNotifierItem Title

dock._width: pixels, or 'auto' = items x (icon + gap) + separator, sized from the scaled values, so the padding is even on both ends.
dock._apps: Known ids: files, browser, settings, trash, downloads, ide; "|" draws the separator (Figma dock) (older ids finder, chrome, fdm, idea still work). Add your own with entries like {"name":"Terminal","exec":"qterminal","icon":"utilities-terminal"}.
dock._mode: How the dock behaves: 'auto-hide' (default) = hidden, shown when the pointer reaches the bottom edge, and it reserves no screen space; 'reserve' = reserves its full bottom edge; 'always-on-top' = floats above windows, reserves nothing; 'intelligent-hide' = hides while a window overlaps it (LXQt does not respond to overlap here). Switch with: ./dock.sh --dock-mode <mode>
dock._scale: Dock size follows the screen like the macOS dock does. 'auto' = primary screen width / 1512 (the Figma reference width), so a 1920 px screen gives 1.27. Or a number such as 1.0 to keep the Figma pixel sizes.
dock._backend: 'lxqt-panel' (default) or 'plank' (experimental, needs: sudo apt install plank). The LXQt panel paints its window opaque, so border, outer ring, rounded corners, edge offset and blur need Plank.

style._doc: fill 'auto' = Figma dock fill for the mode (dark #4a4a4a 39%, light #f6f6f6 36%) or #rrggbb; opacity 'auto' or 0-100. border = 1 px inner stroke, ring = 1 px outer ring, radius/padding/offset in px, blur = compositor blur behind the dock. Honoured by the lxqt-panel backend: fill, opacity, padding (width). The rest only by plank (offset is not supported by Plank either and is ignored there).
